source_caption:
The Batman doesn’t need to show Bruce Wayne’s parents being murdered again because Matt Reeves finds a more subtle way to echo that trauma: Bruce looking at the mayor’s son after he loses his father. In that quiet stare, Robert Pattinson shows recognition, grief, and helplessness all at once — Batman isn’t watching a stranger, he’s seeing the moment that created him.

The Batman (2022), directed by Matt Reeves, starring Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz, Paul Dano. A dark, rain-soaked detective noir that reimagines Gotham through corruption, obsession, and fear, following a younger Batman still learning what his symbol truly means.

source_details.title: The Batman
source_details.synopsis: The Batman is a 2022 American superhero film directed by Matt Reeves from a screenplay he wrote with Peter Craig. Based on the DC Comics character Batman, it is a reboot of the Batman film franchise. Robert Pattinson stars as Bruce Wayne / Batman alongside Zoë Kravitz, Paul Dano, Jeffrey Wright, John Turturro, Peter Sarsgaard, Andy Serkis, and Colin Farrell. The film follows Batman, in his second year fighting crime in Gotham City, as he uncovers corruption with ties to his own family while pursuing the Riddler (Dano), a mysterious serial killer and terrorist targeting the city's elite.
